recentItems.title: QUEEN OF HEARTS – Valentine's Day Special | Ft. Darshan Jariwala, Smita Jayakar
recentItems.description:
The Valentine Special short film produced by Connect.1 features veteran actors Darshan Jariwala and Smita Jayakar as a couple in the lead role.  The film defies the stereotypical interpretation of Valentine’s Day being all about young love. 

“Queen Of Hearts” is a celebration of love, where the entire Mehta family competes with each other with overt displays of affection.  The Matriarch is the object of everyone’s attention and she seems hard to please. The men are fussing over her and racing against time to win her heart. What neither of them knows is that while they are busy with the delicate dance of courtship and love, Cupid has already decided their fate!

Connect.1 is the digital arm of India’s well-known motion picture studios Mukta Arts Limited. It aims to be the ultimate destination to showcase the best short films.
